summary: Backend-only testing for 'Mis Negocios' API. Created pytest suite covering auth, business/product/customer/sale/transaction CRUD, stock entries, cross-user isolation, dashboard aggregation, and AI endpoints (Claude Haiku 4.5 via Emergent LLM Key). 28/28 tests PASSED. Seeded two users (A/B) directly in MongoDB test_database per /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Verified: invalid session_id -> 401; /auth/me 200 with Bearer, 401 without/with bad token; logout invalidates session; businesses scoped by user_id with 404 cross-user; products CRUD + stock-entry increments stock AND creates matching egreso transaction (qty*unit_cost); sales reject empty items with 400, decrement product stock, compute total, and create ingreso transaction only when paid>0; invalid transaction type -> 400; dashboard returns today_sales_total/count, products_total, low_stock_count/items, capital=income-expense, customers_total; AI chat returns non-empty Spanish reply, AI product-description returns non-empty description; both AI endpoints require auth and business ownership (401/404). Note: /app/backend/pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; this suite uses shared-state across classes (biz_a_id, prod_a_id, cust_a_id), so it MUST be run serially with `-n 0`. Running with the default addopts causes AttributeError on cross-worker state. Suite is otherwise self-cleaning (TEST_-prefixed data removed via session-scoped fixture teardown).

minor.issue: Session token comes from upstream OAuth payload; same session_token could in theory be inserted twice if replayed. Unique index on session_token is set at startup so a replay would error 500 due to Mongo duplicate key rather than a clean 409/401. Low risk but worth guarding with an upsert.
low_stock_items is capped to 10, but low_stock_count returns the FULL count. Documented behavior - not a bug, just worth noting for frontend pagination.

No validation that product_id in items actually belongs to the business; stock is decremented via $inc so a non-existent product silently no-ops and total is still computed. Consider validating each item.product_id exists under business.

action_items: Pytest suite must be run with `-n 0` (serial) because tests share module-level state across classes and /app/backend/pytest.ini uses `-n 2 --dist loadscope`. Consider refactoring tests to use session-scoped fixtures for created IDs if parallelism is desired.
(Optional hardening) In create_sale, validate each item.product_id belongs to the business (return 400/404 if not).
(Optional hardening) In auth_session, use upsert on session_token to tolerate replays cleanly instead of risking duplicate-key 500.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 676 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting routers (auth, businesses, products, customers, sales, transactions, ai, dashboard) into separate modules.
All MongoDB find/find_one calls correctly exclude `_id` via {'_id': 0}. Good.
All API routes correctly prefixed with /api via api_router. Good.
Env vars read via os.environ (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME required; EMERGENT_LLM_KEY optional with runtime check). No hardcoding. Good.
require_business returns 404 for cross-user access rather than 403 - acceptable (hides existence) and matches review request expectation.
AI endpoints wrap llm calls in try/except and return 502 with message - good resilience.
seed_data_creation: Two users (A, B) seeded in MongoDB test_database via session-scoped fixtures with session_tokens; one business, one product, one customer, two sales, two manual transactions created for user A. All TEST_-prefixed data cleaned up on session teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To run: `cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest -v -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. The `-n 0` is REQUIRED because pytest.ini defaults to `-n 2 --dist loadscope` and tests share state across classes via pytest module attributes. Backend URL defaults to http://localhost:8001 (use BACKEND_URL env to override). Tests seed users/sessions directly in Mongo per /app/memory/test_credentials.md. AI tests make real calls to Emergent LLM (Claude Haiku 4.5) and take ~5-15s total.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no failures. Initial parallel test run with default pytest.ini addopts (-n 2 --dist loadscope) failed 14 tests with AttributeError on pytest.biz_a_id because tests across classes ran on different xdist workers and module-level state does not propagate between workers. Resolved by running serially with `-n 0`. All 28 tests pass.
